package studentruntime

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestRuntimeSnapshotToTaskMetadataCarriesLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := &domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot{
		ID:              "runtime-task",
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "web.catalog.render-products", Version: "v1"}},
	}

	metadata, err := runtimeSnapshotToTaskMetadata(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("map runtime snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	if len(metadata.LearningTargets) != 1 || metadata.LearningTargets[0] != snapshot.LearningTargets[0] {
		t.Fatalf("learning targets were not preserved: %#v", metadata.LearningTargets)
	}
}
